title: Unique Paths II
description: A robot starts at the top-left of a grid and may move only right or down. A cell containing 1 is blocked; 0 is open. Return the number of paths to the bottom-right cell. If the start or finish is blocked, return 0.
constraints: The number of valid paths fits in a signed 32-bit integer.
hints: Define a dynamic-programming state for each prefix of the inputs.
Update each state using only valid preceding states and the allowed transitions.
